name: @sand/hooks
description: Hook files: small TypeScript files in ~/.sand/hooks or <project>/.sand/hooks that change prompts, decide on tool calls, pick models and more

sand.label: Hooks
sand.summary: Runs your hook files at each turn, step and tool call, and shows what they did in the thread

uses.ui: no trust prompt for project hooks, no notices and no /hooks command
uses.transcript: what hooks did is not shown in the thread
